description: Declarative Layer-2 builder for an ordered SOP geometry chain. Pass an `ops` list (type + optional name + optional params); each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1] under `parent` (default `/project1`). Per-op create/param/connect failures become warnings (fail-forward) — a partial chain still returns useful info. Tip: end the chain in a `nullSOP` for a stable handoff to Geometry COMPs, SOP-to-CHOP, or convertSOP. Use `connect_nodes` for multi-input fan-in (e.g. mergeSOP, copySOP template).

name.description: Base name for the chain; used as a name prefix when ops omit `name`, and as the chain's reported id.

ops.description: Ordered list of SOPs. Each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1].

name.description: Optional explicit node name. Defaults to '<name>_<i>_<typeStem>' (the type with trailing SOP stripped).

params.description: Parameter name → value map applied after creation. A string value matching an earlier op's name resolves to that op's absolute path (useful for `sop` refs on copySOP, mergeSOP, etc.).

type.description: SOP operator type (e.g. `boxSOP`, `sphereSOP`, `gridSOP`, `transformSOP`, `noiseSOP`, `mergeSOP`, `copySOP`, `nullSOP`). Must end with `SOP`.

name: build_sop_geometry
title: Build SOP geometry chain
